system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
Merge channels per precedence (human
> safety > clarity > persuasion).
system_prompt_style.note: Context/prompt assembled at runtime from human overrides, safety signals, Critic suggestions; clarity vs persuasion prompts switch by phase.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
Screening reduces un-
certainty about counterparty attributes via information elicitation.
env_context_strategy.note: No repository/environment; context comes from dialogue elicitation, not an environment context injector.

context_compaction.evidence_quote:
fitToBudget applies a compression policy to meet con-
text window limits (typically 8K–32K tokens depending on model).

observation_format.evidence_quote:
Scope is currently bilateral and
text-based; multi-party, multimodal, and consumer contexts require
extensions.

tool_count.evidence_quote:
ObservableActions ={ask, summarize, propose,
check_safety, escalate, approve, decline}
tool_count.note: Counted the protocol's observable action set; no tool schemas are specified.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote:
𝐴 includes ObservableActions ={ask, summarize, propose,
check_safety, escalate, approve, decline}
edit_primitive.note: Action set contains no file-editing primitive.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote:
Tool integrations: verification APIs (certifications, back-
ground checks), data lookups.
protocol_standardization.note: Listed only as a future protocol extension; no standard protocol named.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
States:START → STCC→
SCREEN→ NEGOTIATE→ SUMMARIZE→ {AGREE, NO_DEAL,
ESCALATE, STALL}.
loop_primitives.note: A gated state machine; Critic feedback adds a critique-then-revise element.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
A phased workflow advances through START→ a high-
value opening question
planning_granularity.note: Phases are fixed by the protocol; no agent-authored plan object (TCI ledger tracks information, not plan steps).

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
three essential roles—Principal (human), Delegate (LLM agent), and
Counterparty—with an optional Critic to enhance performance
multi_agent_topology.note: Delegate is the acting agent; Critic and Moderator are auxiliary LLM roles feeding it in a fixed order.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
Multi-party (𝑛> 2): role generalization and coalition han-
dling.
delegation_mechanism.note: No agent-to-agent delegation; escalation targets a human Principal.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote:
escalation is mandatory
when the agent detects potential unauthorized commitments
human_in_loop.note: Approval requested per boundary-crossing message; SUMMARIZE→AGREE requires commitments within authorization.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Persist state summaries andTCIledger to memory.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote:
Memory systems: cross-session learning, preference stores
with freshness/decay policies.
long_term_memory.note: Cross-session memory listed only as a protocol extension, not in the default design.

state_persistence.evidence_quote:
Asynchronous communication: resumable states, timeout
and resume policies.
state_persistence.note: Listed as an extension; state summaries and TCI ledger are persisted per transition.

self_verification.evidence_quote: (2) Critic suggestions (AI-generated tactical advice), and (3) safety signals
self_verification.note: Moderator few-shot classifier judges dialogue; Critic critiques the Delegate's drafts.

retry_policy.evidence_quote:
Re-enter SCREEN ifTCIinsufficient or Moderator confi-
dence low.
retry_policy.note: Within-session re-entry to SCREEN, but no task-level retry of a whole attempt.

rollback.evidence_quote:
PreflightCommitmentCheck de-
tects binding phrases, rewriteNonBinding converts to ten-
tative language
rollback.note: Messages are rewritten before sending; no state rollback mechanism specified.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
Terminal states are: AGREE (successful deal), NO_DEAL
(impasse), ESCALATE (human review needed), or STALL (timeout).
termination_condition.note: Stall: 'IfTCIdelta ≈ 0 for K rounds'; STALL also on timeout/inactivity.

permission_model.evidence_quote:
Each draft message undergoes commitment detection; viola-
tions trigger escalation with full context rather than silent rejection.
permission_model.note: Authorization boundaries plus preflight checks act as a rule-based policy engine; violations route to per-call human approval.

tracing.evidence_quote:
The system logs: state transitions (START → STCC
→ SCREEN, etc.),TCIledger at each turn (revealed vs. missing
fields)

eval_hooks.evidence_quote:
Status: conceptual blueprint; large-scale empirical validation
is future work.
eval_hooks.note: Evaluation is a proposed blueprint; no shipped evaluation runner.

guardrails.evidence_quote:
ModeratorClassify flags suspicious
requests, selective abstention routes low-confidence classi-
fications to CLARIFY.
guardrails.note: Output: rewriteNonBinding of drafts; actions: boundary checks before every message.

target_domain.evidence_quote:
a governance-first framework for
LLM-human agency in B2B negotiation and screening
target_domain.note: Domain is B2B negotiation/screening (procurement, real estate, staffing).

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: context window limits (typically 8K–32K tokens depending on model)
model_agnostic.note: No specific model or vendor is required by the specification.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote:
This is a theory -first framework. We have not established effect
sizes or external validity through large-scale empirical studies.

first_release_date.note: Basis: arXiv v1 date; no code release.
